# Toza

> Personal digital protection for your close circle. Toza is an in-person, senior-expert service for people in high-stakes personal disputes or post-incident uncertainty, helping them find, explain, and reduce personal digital exposure before it becomes leverage.

The service is not generic IT support, remote helpdesk work, investigation, forensic reconstruction, legal evidence collection, monitoring, or SaaS.

## Start here

- [Private Exposure Assessment](/en/private-exposure-assessment.html) — ₪3,500. A private, in-person diagnostic. The fee is credited in full toward a full package booked within 14 days.
- [Pricing](/en/pricing.html)
- [What Happens During the Visit](/en/what-happens-during-the-visit.html)

## Full packages

- Personal Shield — ₪14,000. One person, one day, one primary phone, with every relevant account identified together during the engagement.
- Inner Circle Shield — from ₪38,000. Multi-person engagement scoped after assessment.
- Bespoke Private Protection — by arrangement for unusual or highly complex situations.

Additional devices, people, home network/router work, vehicle access review, and urgent handling are scoped separately. Annual review or retainer services are available only after a full package.

## Common situations

- [Separation & Divorce](/en/separation-divorce.html)
- [Business Dispute](/en/business-dispute.html)
- [They Know Something They Shouldn't](/en/they-know-something.html)
- [Inheritance Conflict](/en/inheritance-clash.html)
- [Leaving a Controlling Relationship](/en/leaving-controlling-relationship.html)
- [Commercial Spying](/en/commercial-spying.html)
- [Private Investigator Defence](/en/private-investigator.html)

## Boundaries

In person. With the client present. No remote access. No cloud processing of the client's private material. No retained logs of the client's digital life. No investigation of the other side. No forensic reconstruction. No legal advice. No guarantee that no exposure remains.

See [FAQ and boundaries](/en/faq.html#boundaries) and [Why This Is Not IT Support](/en/not-it-support.html).

## Founder / professional record

The founder's professional record is maintained at https://cyberdrtabansky.com.

## For attorneys

- [For attorneys](/en/attorneys.html)

The service may provide a private dated record of work performed and, where appropriate, an attorney-friendly summary. It is not a forensic report, legal opinion, evidence document, legal certification, or guarantee.

## Contact

Current first contact is via WhatsApp or Signal. Send only a short neutral first message; do not send passwords, recovery codes, legal documents, intimate details, or detailed allegations in the first contact.
